verdict.rationale: Resend documents a dedicated batch endpoint, `POST /emails/batch`, that sends up to 100 messages in one request, which covers the core of replacing a per-recipient loop. The evidence does not show the per-message status or IDs returned in the response, and does not say explicitly that each message can carry its own personalized content. Missing for 10: documented per-message status/IDs in the batch response, explicit per-message personalization, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a batch of personalized emails in a single API request with per-message status in the response, instead of looping one call per recipient

citations.quote: Trigger up to 100 batch emails at once.
Send batch email (up to 100 messages per request) via `POST https://api.resend.com/emails/batch`.
